title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
**ORACLE MIDDAY BRIEF**

Bitcoin holding $64,506—modest gains but conviction's missing. Fear gauge deep in extreme territory at 20, signaling capitulation vibes across the market.

On-chain picture's constructive though. Hashrate sitting healthy at 826.7 exahash, no miner exodus signals. Mempool's clean with over 112k transactions queued—network digesting volume smoothly. Fastest fees hovering around 4 sat per byte keeps retail accessible.
